answer: Each agent must bond a unique device attestation plus tokens; forging N identities costs N times the bond and hardware, making sybil farms economically irrational. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity anchored to a verifiable hardware root. Like a marble lodged on a ridge above a river, each identity rests on one physical anchor that cannot be duplicated cheaply. Duplicate attestations are slashed, so attackers lose capital with every fake node they spin up. This model fits agent Agent0045's threat model.
